decisions.statement: A watcher that is running is reported with its process id, its uptime and its log path.
One watcher runs for the whole workstation.
Whether the watcher is running is read from systemd.
How long the watcher has been up is read from the file the watcher wrote when the watcher started.
A watcher that is not running has no process id.

definition: the command saying whether the workstation watcher is running
